title: Hooska Carshiga Gadaashiisa
intro: Waxaad taagan tahay gudaha maxkamadaha boqortooyo qadiimi ah oo xoog badan, halkaas oo taliye awood leh uu isku sheegay inuu yahay ilaah dadka oo dhan ka sarreeya. Taliyahan waxaa agtiisa taagan addoon daacad ah, oo loo igmaday himilooyinka ugu waaweyn ee boqortooyada. Iyagoo wada jira, way shirqoolaan oo qorsheeyaan, iyagoo diidaya inay dhegeystaan ​​digniinaha rasuul loo soo diray inuu hago. Ma ogaan kartaa cidda addoonkan daacadda ah ahaa?
clues: Waxaan ku noolaa boqortooyo xooggan oo uu xukumo shakhsi awood badan oo sheegtay ilaahnimo dadka oo dhan.
Waxaan u shaqeeyay sidii wasiir lagu kalsoon yahay oo uu u adeegay taliyahan, anigoo fulinaya hamigooda iyo amarkooda oo dhan.
Markii rasuul Alle yimid dhulkeenna oo naga yeeraya runta, aniga iyo taliyahayguba waan diidnay inaan dhegaysanno.
Waxaa la i faray inaan shido dab weyn oo aan diyaariyo leben dhoobo ah si aan u sameeyo dhisme weyn.
Hoggaamiyahaygu wuxuu rabay inuu dhiso dhisme aad u dheer oo gaaraya cirka laftiisa.
Ugu dambeyntii, aniga iyo taliyahaygii, ciidankeennii, ayaa la qaaday oo lagu qarqiyay biyaha qotoda dheer ee badda.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
